args.title: Fix amount parsing for zero-decimal currencies with dot thousands separators
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Fix `parseAmount` so that when parsing amounts for zero-decimal currencies (such as CLP), thousand separators like dots (e.g. "12.500" or "-1.250.000") are correctly handled instead of being treated as decimal points.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`parseAmount` strips commas but doesn't handle dots as thousands separators when parsing zero-decimal currencies, causing amounts like "12.500" to be parsed as 12.5 instead of 12500.
